headline: Rico Auto Industries Ltd awarded Best Supplier of the Year for on-time delivery performance
article_text: Industry apex association presented Rico Auto Industries Ltd with the Gold Vendor Trophy recognizing superior delivery fulfillment and consistent six-sigma quality standards.

headline: Unscheduled maintenance shutdown announced by Pidilite Industries Ltd
article_text: Operations at Pidilite Industries Ltd will be curtailed over the coming fortnight due to urgent overhaul requirements on high-pressure forging and casting machinery.

headline: Subros Ltd inaugurates high-tech automated manufacturing wing
article_text: Aiming to satisfy rising automotive OEM demand, Subros Ltd has commissioned a new ₹220 crore manufacturing wing with advanced robotic inspection cells, increasing annual throughput by 35%.

headline: Amtek Auto Ltd reports unexpected equipment outage at key manufacturing facility
article_text: A major machinery breakdown at Amtek Auto Ltd's manufacturing unit has halted primary assembly lines. Preliminary inspections indicate repairs may take several weeks, leading to order dispatch backlogs.
